rv.q: The clarity and restrained opulence of the production are more satisfying, unfortunately, than the caliber of the performances, which tend toward blandness or overstatement.
It's hard to remember the last time barely controlled entropy was this kind of good, clean fun.

cn.t: Shakespeare's convoluted fairy tale gets a solid production that navigates the play's crowded climax and numerous revelations with competence, though critics suggest the staging doesn't fully transcend the material's inherent challenges.

vs.sum: The Vivian Beaumont Theater offers exceptional sightlines and sound quality due to its unique thrust stage design, ensuring a great view and auditory experience from nearly every seat. While the ambiance is enhanced by its location within the Lincoln Center, the comfort level is average with some reports of tight seating, and facilities are typical for a Broadway venue.

acc.note: Orchestra accessible via elevator. Induction hearing loop for t-coil. Loge NOT accessible (stairs only).
